Name: Train Info
Author: BinaryLip
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Config Options[/size]
[font=Courier New]NotificationTime[/font] - sets what time to display the notification that a train is coming tomorrow (default 1800 aka 6 PM)

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 or later on Windows/Linux/Mac
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer (host needs to have the mod for the train contents to be displayed)
[*]No known mod conflicts
[/list]
[size=5]Specific Mod integrations[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ - UI for editing config options
[/list]
[size=5]Limitations[/size]
[list]
[*]The train will NOT appear if you quit and reload the day it's supposed to arrive.
[*]The game doesn't actually determine the number/type of the train cars until it starts passing through the valley (~20 in-game minutes after the global "A train is passing through Stardew Valley" notification) so that's the earliest that I can display the contents of the train.
[/list]
[size=5]Translations[/size]
[list]
[*]French - provided by [url=https://github.com/CaranudLapin]CaranudLapin[/url]
[*]German - provided by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/58067946]Th3Tob1[/url]
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/BinaryLip/TrainInfo]Source code[/url]
[*]My other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19305]Schedule Viewer[/url]!
[/list]
